headline: Consistent and meaningful execution!

highlights: In Q2FY27, Bharti Airtel (Bharti) had strong performance across segments with India mobile and non-mobile EBITDA growth of 11.3% YoY and 14.5% YoY, respectively.
Bhart’s incremental focus is to drive faster growth from new areas of digital services, data centres and cloud offering.
Africa continues its strong run, with 6.3% QoQ revenue growth in USD terms.
Steady growth in non-mobile businesses 1) Home services: Number of home broadband customers grew 4.6% QoQ/ 28.9% YoY to 15mn.
valuation: Our SoTP-based TP is revised to INR 2,430 (from INR 2,410) as we keep valuation multiples unchanged.

Risks • Downside risks: 1) Market share loss in mobile business; and 2) rise in competitive and regulatory intensities. • Upside risks: 1) Higher-than-expected tariff hike; and 2) continued rise in market share in mobile and home businesses.
